human_hints.title: Chatter
human_hints.summary: People talking about peaceful and heavenly places (like a seashore table)

human_hints.title: Lead vocal
human_hints.summary: Lead vocal chill sing, 1 bar notes

human_hints.title: Cut into breakdown
human_hints.summary: Drums, bass and vocal all cut at once. The hard entry into the chatter breakdown.

human_hints.title: Build like
human_hints.summary: Snares duplicating time (rising) to pace up the chorus energy, similar to a drop (not a drop, but main chorus)

human_hints.title: Drums cut
human_hints.summary: All drums stop dead for ~5 beats after the snare run — the highest-tension moment of the passage. Only a single pickup snare at 127.195 breaks it, 75 ms before the chorus downbeat.

human_hints.title: Drop
human_hints.summary: The chorus at bar 64 is a drop (operator-confirmed): the hit lands at 127.0 with the bass entry, just ahead of the bar-64 downbeat at 127.27 and its harmonic stab, straight out of the drum cut. The vocal entry re-hits at 131.086. Peak on 127.0; 131.1 is the second hit, not the payoff.

human_hints.title: Grid runs a beat early
human_hints.summary: The beat grid gives bar 64 only three beats (127.27 / 127.76 / 128.24, bar 65 at 128.73), so its bar numbers run one beat early through this chorus. True downbeats, confirmed by beat accents: 127.27, 129.21, 131.15, 133.09, 135.04, 136.98, 138.92, 140.87. The chorus 'kick' drum events sit half a beat off the grid (median 230-240 ms, in every chorus): they are the off-beat bass pump, not the kick.

human_hints.title: Kick doubles
human_hints.summary: Bar 79 loads the transition: the kick goes quarter to eighth (156.059 / 156.300 / 156.541), and three crashes land on beat 3 at 156.659-156.902 — the first crashes in 30 seconds. Snares run the bar out at 157.27 and 157.52.

human_hints.title: Late impact
human_hints.summary: Same trap as 127.27, half a second wide: the section boundary is not the payoff. gesture-045's tension resolves at 158.45, the peak hit (kick+snare+crash together) is at 158.841, and a sustained crash wash follows. Drums enter at 157.25 for the rest of the song and vocals drop out entirely.

human_hints.title: Outro, drums and bass out
human_hints.summary: Drums and bass stop. The pads fade out.
